## Problem statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected and how often?

## Proposed solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible — include the component or layer of the system this would touch (Governor, Strategy, Backtesting, Desktop UI, etc.).

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you evaluate? Why is your proposed solution better?

## Additional context

Any mockups, related issues, or reference implementations that could help.
